vulnerable_statements.reason: mt76_connac_get_he_phy_cap() can return NULL, for example when the band or interface type has no HE capability data. The return value is never checked, so vc can be NULL here.
This reads ve->phy_cap_info[5]. ve comes from a vc pointer that may be NULL, so the read dereferences a NULL-based pointer and crashes the kernel (denial of service).

suggested_fix: Check the return value of mt76_connac_get_he_phy_cap() before using it. If vc is NULL, return early (do not set up HE beamformer fields) and only then compute ve = &vc->he_cap_elem. This is the same NULL check the driver's other uses of this helper need.
